operations.title: Complete coalition table
operations.mission: Return the ordered three-symbol coalition table with every declared worth.

operations.title: Marginal contribution table
operations.mission: List all twelve one-symbol marginal contributions with their exact source and destination coalitions.

operations.title: Mobius interaction dividends
operations.mission: Compute all eight coalition dividends by the declared Boolean-lattice transform.

operations.title: Permutation-average allocation
operations.mission: Average marginal contributions over all six orders using reduced rational pairs.

operations.title: Uniform-subset marginal mean
operations.mission: Average the four marginal contributions for each symbol; do not assume their sum is the grand worth.

operations.title: Dummy and null-symbol audit
operations.mission: Distinguish constant standalone contribution from identically zero contribution across all contexts.

operations.title: Exchange-symmetry pairs
operations.mission: Find symbol pairs whose contributions agree in every coalition excluding both.

operations.title: Monotonicity cover countermodels
operations.mission: Retain every negative increment on a one-symbol cover edge.

operations.title: Disjoint-coalition inequality audit
operations.mission: Retain disjoint-coalition witnesses where joining loses declared worth.

operations.title: Convex-game inequality audit
operations.mission: Check every finite pair inequality and retain all violating coalition pairs.

operations.title: Allocation conservation residual
operations.mission: Compare the exact allocation sum with grand-coalition worth without rounding.

operations.title: Standalone-worth deficit audit
operations.mission: Report exact positive shortfalls against each symbol standalone worth.

operations.title: Coalition excess profile
operations.mission: Report every coalition worth minus its assigned allocation sum.

operations.title: Given-allocation core membership
operations.mission: Check efficiency and all coalition inequalities for one supplied allocation only.

operations.title: Bounded integer imputation grid
operations.mission: Enumerate nonnegative integer allocations in the zero-to-twelve cube satisfying efficiency and standalone constraints.

operations.title: Complement dual transformation
operations.mission: Produce the complement dual table while preserving the original game unchanged.

operations.title: Accessible coalition summary
operations.mission: Represent exact table size and worth range while reserving human comprehensibility evaluation.

operations.title: Allocation review handover
operations.mission: Represent the supplied allocation and its conservation residual without granting release authority.

operations.title: Real-utility observation gap
operations.mission: Bind missing observation, calibration and independent-review prerequisites to this synthetic game.

operations.title: Consequential allocation authority hold
operations.mission: Keep actual authority and external action false for this declared allocation.
